content: Devensoft models integration as Workstreams (functional team activity sets, e.g. HR) containing SubWorkstreams (e.g. Health Insurance, 401k). Synergy tracking module treats synergy as a typed financial-value record (savings or cost) tied to workstream/task, with dashboards + ROI analysis. Platform = 7 integrated modules spanning pipeline/deal, due diligence, PMI/execution, synergy tracking, legal workflow, reporting -- i.e. DD, synergy and reporting are separate but linked modules in a mature competitor, not bolted onto tasks.
